invariants.statement: The move class that cures a hold is never deferred by that hold (CL-013: exemption classes for availability-critical operations).
Any undeclared (hold, moveClass) combination resolves to defer; an unknown move never silently bypasses a hold.

The hold's own side-effects must not starve cure planning: the ledger_surplus_drain planning capability, once minted from concentration evidence by the admission owner, is consumed by the move planner regardless of the READY projection. An engaged quorum-spread hold withholds joiner READY leases, so a READY-conditioned consumer would suppress the drain the hold is waiting for and leave the hold without a reachable release path (quest ledger-quorum-spread-hold-cure-drain-admission).

rules.reason: A REPLACE/REMOVE of a ledger partition admits only into an idle ledger; co-scheduling is the run-20 formation interlock.
Control-plane spine availability outranks storm avoidance; ledger spread recovery must stay admissible through the hold it cures (CL-013).
While a live ledger self-move exists every other operation defers; the CL-043 staleness exclusion bounds a wedged holder.
The count-neutral spread REPLACE is the cure for a concentrated ledger quorum and must pass the hold it releases.
Emergency quorum-restore ADDs rebuild the spine the hold protects.
Dependent admission defers until placement actuals show the ledger quorum spread (run-22 release-too-early gap).
